final_test_note: The diagnostic receives only the existing outer training partition; final-test features, labels, and scores are not passed to this function.

feature_importance.caveat: Correlated predictors can split or distort importance; permutation is not causal and uses this validation window.

pipeline_audit.feature_engineering: Reviewed functions use rolling, differencing, EMA, and percentage-change operations on current and earlier rows; no negative shifts are used for features.
pipeline_audit.labels: Forward return uses Close.shift(-h), then drops the last h rows within each symbol before symbols are concatenated.
pipeline_audit.split: Outer split is by sorted unique dates, with a horizon-sized purge; diagnostic fit/validation is also chronological with a horizon-sized date purge.
pipeline_audit.data_cleaning: Training concatenates per-symbol features and labels, drops rows with missing values, then replaces remaining NaN/infinite feature values with zero before fitting.
limitations: Moving-average ratios and MACD components are related by construction; feature correlation does not establish harmful leakage.
All securities share a common validation period, but models do not include index, sector, or cross-asset context.
This single validation window is for diagnosis; repeated rolling-origin validation is needed before adopting changes.

random_forest_configured.description: Existing configured RF; unchanged parameters, uncalibrated.

random_forest_balanced_subsample.description: Same forest settings with per-bootstrap class balancing.

random_forest_deeper_smaller_leaves.description: Exploratory capacity increase; validation-only comparison, not production tuning.

extra_trees.description: ExtraTrees alternative with the configured tree count, depth, leaf size, and seed.

scaled_logistic_regression.description: Scaled multinomial linear baseline; scaler is fitted on the fit window only.

selection_rule: Ranked by validation macro-F1 for inspection only; compare balanced accuracy, log loss, and class recalls jointly. No model is selected or deployed by this diagnostic.
